pages.title: Attoscale Inductor
pages.text: An inductor wound from the field lines of a magnetic monopole, which have no south pole to close on. The energy it stores has nowhere to leak to. It is invisible to the eye, but compasses left nearby swing slowly round and point straight at it.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Femto Fabricator I threaded a Femtoscale Inductor around a Magnetic Monopole with Exotic Solder. The monopole's field lines wound into the coil and never came out.
